query:
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fuel_records WHERE payment_status = 'paid') as total_fuel_paid,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM subscription_charges WHERE status = 'paid') as total_subscriptions_paid,
  (SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM fuel_records WHERE payment_status = 'paid') as total_fuel_revenue,
  (SELECT SUM(value) FROM subscription_charges WHERE status = 'paid') as total_subscription_revenue;
